QuestionStmt.S: If compressibility factor of real gas is 1.05 at STP. What is molar volume of real gas?

Solution.S:
Compressibility factor $Z$ is defined as:

$$Z = \frac{V_{\text{real}}}{V_{\text{ideal}}}$$

At STP, the molar volume of an ideal gas is:

$$V_{\text{ideal}} = 22.4 \text{ dm}^3$$

Given:

$$Z = 1.05$$

Substitute the values:

$$1.05 = \frac{V_{\text{real}}}{22.4}$$

$$V_{\text{real}} = 1.05 \times 22.4 = 23.52 \text{ dm}^3$$

Thus the molar volume of the real gas is 23.52 dm³, which corresponds to option C.
